notes_for_editor: Very thin evidence. The Firelookout.ca page shows N/A for every field, and nothing else reachable mentions Bangor. The record's coordinates (45.31667, -77.71556) are unverified and no source places the tower. Story is about 110 words, just under the usual 120-word floor, because nothing further sourced could be added without padding. Two WebSearch calls used; a Facebook group post on Ontario towers could not be read beyond its title. Worth checking the 1963 Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map or Forest History Ontario's archive for Bangor before any expansion.
